method: Hybrid ILA-CKKS Sensitive Tensor Aggregation + Plaintext Residual Multi-Krum
aggregation: HE-assisted Multi-Krum over ILA-selected sensitive tensors with plaintext residual aggregation
selection_strategy: client-side Information Leakage-Aware metadata selection for sensitive HE path
functional_he_update_scope: ILA-selected sensitive trainable tensors use HE aggregation; non-selected residual trainable tensors use plaintext aggregation
privacy_architecture_note: Server role does not receive plaintext ILA-selected sensitive updates, but does receive plaintext non-selected residual updates. Trusted authority decrypts distance scores and final selected sensitive-tensor aggregate. Single-process prototype simulates all roles in one runtime.
hybrid_design: ILA-selected sensitive tensors are HE-aggregated; lower-risk residual tensors are plaintext-aggregated from same Multi-Krum-selected clients.

history.distance_visibility: Server receives distance scores and selected indices, not plaintext selected client tensors.
history.selection_strategy: client-side ILA metadata; score = update_norm * fisher_score * gradient_variance
history.hybrid_update_scope: ILA-selected high-leakage tensors use CKKS/HE aggregation; non-selected lower-risk residual tensors use plaintext aggregation from the same Multi-Krum-selected clients.
history.functional_he_update_scope: ILA-selected high-leakage trainable tensors are HE-aggregated; non-selected residual trainable tensors are plaintext-aggregated from same selected clients
known_leakage: selected sensitive tensor names and sizes
